definitions.explanation: A piece of cloth with a distinctive design, used as a symbol.
A large piece of cloth bearing a message or design.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{旗|はた}は{日の丸|ひのまる}だ。

notes:
{旗|はた} refers to flags and banners.

COMPOUNDS:
- {国旗|こっき}: national flag
- {白旗|しらはた}: white flag (surrender)
- {旗印|はたじるし}: banner, slogan

EXPRESSIONS:
- {旗|はた}を{揚|あ}げる: to raise a flag, to start a cause
- {旗色|はたいろ}が{悪|わる}い: things look bad
